explanation: The bounded region has upper surface g=−√(x²+y²) and lower surface h=y²−2. Writing r=√(x²+y²), the upward cone contributes −z²g_x−x=r²(x/r)−x=xr−x. The downward cylinder contributes x because h_x=0 and F's y-component is zero. Their sum is xr, option b. Options d and e also integrate to zero by symmetry, but b is the directly derived integrand.
